nph.text: In New Phyrexia, Elesh Norn, the Grand Cenobite of the white-aligned faction, rises to dominate her fellow praetors after the new Phyrexians split into five factions, each led by a praetor.
She lays waste to Urabrask's domain, so that the Mirrans flee to mountain shelters, and she takes over Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains and is crowned.
Norn also sought to help induct Karn as the Father of Machines, intending to install a puppet, and she compleats the captured Atraxa, marking Phyrexia's final victory over Mirrodin.

one.text: In Phyrexia: All Will Be One, Elesh Norn, the Mother of Machines, becomes the dominant praetor after overwhelming Sheoldred's and Urabrask's forces, and she uses the tyrite to create Realmbreaker, New Phyrexia's World Tree.
She bargains with Tezzeret, granting him a darksteel body in return for his Planar Bridge and Reality Chip, and she welcomes Karn back as the Father of Machines.
When the planeswalker strike team arrives, Norn already knew they were coming and her planar shield scatters them, and she meets the survivors with compleated Nahiri and Nissa at her side.
The survivors refuse to yield, and Norn begins the invasion.

mom.text: In March of the Machine, Elesh Norn, here with her Argent Etchings, sends Realmbreaker's limbs to anchor on planes across the Multiverse and releases pods of Phyrexian forces.
She orders Ajani to execute Sheoldred for craving power over unity, and sends Atraxa to harvest New Capenna after learning of its Halo supply.
Elspeth fights her, and Elspeth's light pierces Norn so that her nightmare becomes flesh, while Jin-Gitaxias turns his army upon her.
Norn rails that she is Phyrexia, but her army tears her apart, and Karn kills her himself.
